confirmed_improvements: Pinned full A16 source definitions are used for original launch/ledger consumption and identity-bearing raw_json parse/visit; original same-object pairs/launch PIDs and parser errors are merged.
parent_wait_proof_valid is a conservative latch rather than hardcoded True. Both collector modes require it plus stable bindings and freshly absent required parent identities.

Parent proof checks typed actual waited/returncodes, wrapper/coordinator same PID-start, inner child-parent relation, temporal enclosure, source_before==after and full expected source membership, ledger equality and actual wrapper exit consistency.
A genuine scientific child rc1 with a valid unchanged-source wait receipt is still retained as scientific FAIL, not converted to a receipt-integrity failure merely for rc1.
Separate preserve-evidence mode keeps original FAIL/unknown and claims only a stable opaque byte snapshot; lossless copier and source/membership end checks remain unchanged.

findings.evidence: The fixed A16 Evidence.visit unconditionally records value[pid] in pid_only even when this same object already supplied an explicit valid PID/start pair. v3 marks all those occurrences missing_same_object_start.
findings.impact: Paired launch/ledger/raw_json objects are falsely counted/labelled as PID-only unknown. This does not mint a pair or relax archive admission, but the unknown report is factually inaccurate.
findings.minimal_fix: Use the A16 identities occurrences at the exact same source+JSON pointer with pid_field=pid to distinguish genuinely unpaired occurrences, or retain this set as generic PID occurrences and label only genuinely unpaired ones unknown. Never borrow a start from a different object.

findings.evidence: The actual frozen execute_chain captured its ASSETS Python set at driver startup. The v3 reviewer reconstructs this from the current directory later.
findings.impact: If a post-wait collector/reviewer .py is first copied into A50, the required source receipt membership falsely grows, parent_wait_proof_valid becomes False, and even preservation mode rejects. No activity artifact was inspected to assert such a change actually occurred.
findings.minimal_fix: Reconstruct that set from the frozen Git asset tree/recorded immutable driver declaration, or keep A50 top-level *.py membership unchanged until the review and collector finish.

remaining_scope_limits: Actual argv is checked for typed nonempty list/cwd and stored receipt consistency, but not reconstructed per frozen phase; this draft does not replace the separate full scientific/qualification argument review.

JSON+launch/ledger and embedded raw_json are freshly parsed. Original external-absence input_bindings for other omitted console streams are retained via the stored report but not all freshly rehashed here. Do not claim a new complete reconsumption of the original absence entire input domain; the copier later hashes every original byte.
